notes.title: WE ARE SORRY
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, I am F King
Lord of the Universe and CEO of Fun & Family & Friends Corp. [/h3]

My accidental little misstep, creating Ascend Bug and breaking the FFF GAME again, is a tragedy that should never have happened. And to all those affected, I want to say we are deeply sorry.

[h3]SORRY...[/h3]

notes.title: MacOS Version and performance update
notes.content:
[b]Hello FFF players,[/b]

We're pleased to announce that FFF is now available on [b]MacOS[/b]! We know that many of our players have been asking for this, and we're excited to be able to deliver. Now, even more players can enjoy the game on their preferred platform.

In addition to the MacOS version, we've also made significant [b]performance improvements[/b] to the game. We've been working on optimizing the code and improving the game's graphics, and as a result, FFF now runs smoother than ever before.

Thank you for your continued support of FFF, and we hope you enjoy the latest version of the game!

notes.title: It's finally happening!
notes.content:
[b]You did not believe us huh? But it's real, the FFF is out![/b]

We really put our best into this game, making it as fun as it can be. 
So If you decide to buy us a coffee by getting it or even write a kind review, it would mean the world to us. But you don't have to... Kevin

FFF Valentine's Day everyone

notes.content:
Yes, we can count...
...everything is fine...

notes.title: 14 Days to go!
notes.content:
[b]It's happening![/b]
No more delays! No more apologies! 
In 14 days, the most FFF game will come out!
God help us all...

notes.title: New screenshots and an even worse apology!
notes.content:
Our lovely friends,

the good thing is that our game is nearly done! Yay! We are planning to send beta keys within the upcoming days for our preselected testers. On the other hand, everyone we spoke to suggested that we are crazy for wanting to release the game in December.

Tho another great reason to postpone the release was that we want to hire a professional voice actor to do the Czech dabbing for one of the characters in the game and also we want to deliver a polished experience.

And what better date for the launch than Valentine's Day?

We love you... you know that.
Polyperfect

notes.title: New trailer and a bad apology!
notes.content:
Hello Friend! It breaks our hearts, but we have decided to delay the FFF game release to 29. November. It seems that we need one more month to find more friends and polish this bad boy. Also, we want to make sure, our grandmas will be proud and that we deliver our first game in the best way we can.  Thanks to that you can expect more gameplay, a richer story, and more silly characters in the final release.

As an apology, we give you a brand-new trailer! 
Thank you for your current support and understanding, Kevin!…

With love and respect, Polyperfect
